product.name: Installed Base Intelligence Platform
product.description: A platform that aggregates, cleanses, and analyzes customer data from multiple sources to provide actionable insights for Industrial OEMs.

product.name: Aftermarket 2.0 Readiness Assessment
product.description: An assessment tool that benchmarks an industrial company's aftermarket strategy against industry leaders.

product.name: Parts Data Cleanup Service
product.description: A service that unifies, cleanses, de-duplicates, and standardizes parts data from multiple sources for Industrial OEMs.

product.name: Installed Base Data Integration
product.description: A data integration service that connects and synchronizes customer and equipment data from diverse systems into a unified platform.

product.name: Marketing Analytics and Customer Segmentation
product.description: A platform feature that provides customer insights, segmentation, and predictive analytics to support targeted marketing campaigns for Industrial OEMs.
